clue.text: Respiratory complaint in New Zealand got by adult inhaling pipe

explanation.surface: Someone catches a chest infection on a trip to New Zealand, perhaps from a grown-up smoking a pipe.
explanation.walkthrough: The inhaling is done by the string 'in New Zealand got by adult' as a whole: the pipe goes inside it, just after the opening word.
explanation.definitionFit: Flu is a viral illness of the airways, so it is fairly called a breathing-related ailment.
